description: Install new dependencies and verify existing test suite passes as baseline. Add weasyprint, jinja2, and markdown to pyproject.toml. Run uv sync, then run existing tests to confirm nothing is broken.
steps: Add 'weasyprint', 'jinja2', and 'markdown' to the dependencies list in apps/api/pyproject.toml
Run 'uv sync' in apps/api/ to install the new dependencies
Run 'uv run pytest tests/ -v' in apps/api/ to confirm existing 88 tests still pass
Run 'uv run ruff check .' in apps/api/ to confirm lint passes
acceptance_criteria: pyproject.toml contains weasyprint, jinja2, and markdown in dependencies
verification: cd apps/api && uv run pytest tests/ -v
cd apps/api && uv run ruff check .
